title: The Appointment That Was Never Booked
title_ja: 予約されなかった診察
fact_notes: 人物・出来事・制度は架空の教材例。実在の調査・統計・実証結果・法令・医療基準ではない。制作台帳は来歴確認用。

sentences.en: A fictional health center introduces an online appointment system to reduce the amount of time that visitors spend waiting at its reception desk.
sentences.ja: 架空の保健施設は受付での待ち時間を減らすオンライン予約システムを導入する。

sentences.en: Staff members initially evaluate the new arrangement by examining the waiting times of people who successfully book an appointment.
sentences.ja: 職員は当初予約できた人の待ち時間を調べて新しい仕組みを評価する。

sentences.en: The recorded figures appear promising, and the manager considers removing the previous telephone booking option.
sentences.ja: 記録数値は有望に見え管理者は従来の電話予約の廃止を考える。

sentences.en: However, an employee asks whether the records contain any information about people who attempted to use the system but were unable to complete a reservation.
sentences.ja: しかし利用を試み予約を完了できなかった人の情報も記録にあるか尋ねる職員がいる。

sentences.en: The staff recognize that a record of successful appointments may exclude people who encountered difficulties at an earlier stage.
sentences.ja: 予約成功の記録には以前の段階で困難に遭った人が含まれない可能性があると認識する。

sentences.en: A person might have trouble finding the relevant information or understanding which fields in a form must be completed.
sentences.ja: 関連情報の発見やフォームの必須欄の理解に苦労する人もいるかもしれない。

sentences.en: Another visitor might lack reliable access to a suitable device, even though the online system itself functions as intended.
sentences.ja: システム自体は意図通り動いていても適切な端末への安定したアクセスがない人もいるかもしれない。

sentences.en: The employees therefore distinguish the efficiency of an established booking from the accessibility of the process through which a booking is obtained.
sentences.ja: そこで成立した予約の効率と予約を取得する手続きの利用しやすさを区別する。

sentences.en: Rather than collecting sensitive medical details, the staff design a hypothetical exercise involving ordinary tasks on a sample version of the appointment website.
sentences.ja: 機微な医療情報を集めず予約サイトの見本版で普通の操作を行う仮想練習を設計する。

sentences.en: They identify points at which users might become confused and examine whether the instructions provide an appropriate way to request assistance.
sentences.ja: 利用者が混乱する箇所を特定し説明が適切な支援依頼方法を提供するか調べる。

sentences.en: The group also considers retaining an alternative booking channel for people whose circumstances make online registration difficult.
sentences.ja: 事情によりオンライン登録が難しい人に別の予約経路を維持することも考える。

sentences.en: It does not claim that a small educational exercise can establish the needs of every actual patient.
sentences.ja: 小規模な教育練習で全実患者の必要を確定できるとは主張しない。

sentences.en: The manager subsequently proposes evaluating the service using several indicators rather than relying exclusively on average waiting time.
sentences.ja: その後管理者は平均待ち時間だけに頼らず複数指標で評価する案を出す。

sentences.en: One indicator would describe the experiences of people who successfully obtained appointments, while another would examine difficulties associated with attempting to obtain them.
sentences.ja: 一指標は予約できた人の体験を示し他は予約取得を試みる際の困難を調べる。

sentences.en: The staff acknowledge that alternative channels may require additional resources and must therefore be considered in relation to the benefits they provide.
sentences.ja: 別経路には追加資源が必要な場合があり提供利益との関係で検討すべきだと認める。

sentences.en: The fictional example does not constitute a recommendation about a particular healthcare facility or a claim about clinical outcomes.
sentences.ja: 架空例は特定医療施設への推奨や臨床結果についての主張ではない。

sentences.en: An apparently improved numerical result may provide only a partial description of the experience that a public service is intended to offer.
sentences.ja: 一見改善した数値結果も公共サービスが提供を意図する体験の一部しか説明しないことがある。

sentences.en: Measurements taken only after people enter a system cannot fully describe barriers that prevent others from entering it.
sentences.ja: 利用開始後だけの測定は他者の利用開始を妨げる障壁を完全に説明できない。

sentences.en: Responsible evaluation therefore requires attention to the process by which people become included in the population being measured.
sentences.ja: 責任ある評価には測定対象集団に含まれるようになる過程への注意が必要だ。

sentences.en: The appointment that was never booked may raise a question that records of completed appointments alone cannot answer.
sentences.ja: 予約されなかった診察は完了予約記録だけでは答えられない問いを提起し得る。

ability to reach or use something
quality of being easy to use

options: To reduce time spent waiting at reception.

questions.prompt: What missing information concerns an employee?
options: Experiences of people who could not complete booking.
questions.explanation_ja: 予約できない人の情報。

questions.prompt: What difficulty could prevent online booking?
options: Lack of reliable access to a device.
Online writing versus medical diagnosis only.
Efficiency after booking versus accessibility of booking itself.
Old devices versus new devices only.
questions.explanation_ja: 予約後の効率と予約へのアクセス。

questions.prompt: What does the educational exercise use?
options: A sample website and ordinary tasks.
Some people may have difficulty registering online.
questions.explanation_ja: オンライン利用困難への配慮。

questions.prompt: What change does the manager propose?
options: Measure only the reception desk size.
Alternative access channels have costs as well as benefits.
Every service can be improved without cost.
Successful bookings describe every user's needs.
Waiting time is the only useful measure.
Online registration must always be abandoned.
Service evaluation should consider people excluded before successful entry.
questions.explanation_ja: 利用に至れない人も考慮。
